card.summary: No free tier. The cheapest plan is USD 9.95 a year, described as 'Cheapest Los Angeles' and 'Works out to $0.83 / month'.

free_tier.stated: No free tier. The cheapest plan is USD 9.95 a year, described as 'Cheapest Los Angeles' and 'Works out to $0.83 / month'.

retention.stated: The container persists while the annual term is paid. A 7-day money-back guarantee is stated; there is no published deletion schedule for non-payment.

egress.terms: 750 GB a month at 10 Gbps on the 1 GB plan. The page states no throttle and no price after the allowance.

record.interface_detail: Root SSH into an LXC container; OS chosen at checkout from Debian, Ubuntu, AlmaLinux or Rocky.
record.tooling: Any SSH client. LXC shares the host kernel, so no custom kernel and no wireguard module of your own.
record.chaining: A 1 GB container with a routed /64 and 750 GB a month for USD 9.95 a year: an IPv6 WireGuard endpoint, a status page or a monitoring probe from a US West Coast address.

limits.value: 750 GB a month of transfer on the 1 GB plan
no IPv4 at all on this plan; IPv4 is USD 24 a year extra, so any IPv4-only peer cannot reach it

record.binding_note: 750 GB a month is the first hard number; the missing IPv4 is a reachability limit rather than a quota, and it fails on the first IPv4-only peer instead.

identity_cost.detail: Self-service order with an email account and a $0 setup fee. The specials page read states no card hold and does not list accepted payment methods, so the card, PayPal or crypto routes are not established.

record.reliability_note: LXC containers share the host kernel; the vendor says so plainly and prices accordingly. no suspension or data-loss event was observed.
record.confidence_note: Price, monthly equivalent, shape, traffic, IPv6 block, IPv4 surcharge and the annual billing term are all quoted from the vendor's specials page read.

evidence.proved: quoted: 'LXC IPv6 Only', '1 GB · 1 core · 15 GB NVMe', '$9.95/year', 'Works out to $0.83 / month'
quoted: '750 GB @ 10 Gbps', '/64 IPv6 subnet', 'No IPv4 - add one for $24/yr'
quoted: '$0 setup fee The annual price is the total due today.' and 'Billed once a year No monthly invoices to keep track of.'
quoted: 'These are Linux containers (LXC), not full virtual machines. A container runs directly on the host's Linux kernel'

record.notes: The vendor advertises the IPv6-only line as suitable for 'tunnel endpoints' and 'monitoring probes', which is the category's use. A WireGuard listener on a public port therefore has a stated route over IPv6; an IPv4 peer needs the USD 24/yr address. Not measured: whether the host kernel exposes the wireguard module to the container.

extras.price_arithmetic: USD 9.95 a year / 12 = USD 0.8292 a month, which the vendor itself prints as '$0.83 / month'. Out of pocket at order: USD 9.95.
extras.payment_methods: not established on the page read
extras.payment_rails: PayPal, credit and debit cards, crypto via NOWPayments, Alipay, iDeal, UPI
